entities.summary: The Ali Gholi Agha Mosque is a Shi'ite mosque in Esfahan, in the province of Isfahan, Iran. Completed in 1122 AH (1710/1711 CE), the mosque was built in the Safavid style by Ali Gholi Agha, who also built the Ali Gholi Agha hammam.
